row: Sammamish Animal Sanctuary is a 501(c)3 non-profit farm animal sanctuary that provides forever homes for abused, neglected, unwanted, and/or homeless barnyard animals. We love sharing videos of the wonderful animals at our sanctuary and spreading the word about our rescued residents.  We are open to the public free of charge so that everyone has the opportunity to enjoy the animals and the peaceful surroundings at our sanctuary.  We operate with nearly 150 volunteers making sure our residents are safe and happy. As we do not receive government funding or large corporate donations, we rely on the generosity of amazing donors to help us pursue our mission.  Please visit our website for donation and volunteer opportunities: sammamishanimalsanctuary.org
